numeric_settings: Frozen from previous independent calibration; no retuning on these tasks.
canonical_sampling: Condition only the first raw token on zero before generating the suffix; do not overwrite completed samples.
routing: Choose the I of the lowest gate-query candidate after up to 256 steps; all phase-two codebooks and amplitudes are fresh.
query_split: Gate and final query sets are independent. Final query is common to all methods and used only for checkpoint/candidate selection. Exact population risk is reporting only.
difficulty_pairing: Same new directions, low amplitudes, low frequencies and frequency offsets across regimes; only high frequency center changes.
compute_budget: 65536 model updates and 8388608 training model-examples for every method. Query and proposal work are separately reported, not equated.
analysis: Report all methods and regimes, known/foreign separately, per-task outcomes, routing accuracy, proposal coverage, measured numeric time, paired task-bootstrap intervals for routed versus canonical AR. Three prior seeds share the same tasks and are not independent task triples.
reason: Prospective follow-up to the completed post-hoc diagnosis: isolate canonical first-token errors, allocation of numerical restarts, and weak codebook fitting. Protocol written before generating new evaluation functions.
